subtitle: Professional Launch Edition — Onboarding, Install & Update Center
changes: Added a responsive optional launch center with direct shortcuts to existing character, build, progression and talent-planning tools.
Introduced device-aware web app installation guidance and a direct install action where the browser supports it, retaining the existing web-app manifest and icons.
Added an on-demand update checker that compares the public release manifest to the current website bundle and offers a reload without clearing saved data.
Published accessible Getting Started and Privacy & Data Guide pages explaining local browser storage, backups, connected Battle.net services, and unofficial Blizzard affiliation.
Kept Talent Forge, all existing saved formats, Music/Media Studio, Blizzard connections, and the confirmed-working Discord announcement workflow intact.
